archimate:ValueStream.name: VS-07.2 Establish Legal and Regulatory Compliance Mechanisms
archimate:ValueStream.documentation:
Next, the organization ensures that all its activities comply with relevant laws and regulations. This includes privacy protection (e.g., GDPR), data-sharing agreements, intellectual property rights, and official statistics legislation.
Compliance mechanisms are formalized in procedures and checklists that apply to all projects and systems. Legal experts and data protection officers review each data flow, ensuring that personal data and confidential information are handled safely and lawfully.
This step ensures that compliance is not optional or reactive, but embedded in every workflow.
Value created: Full alignment with legal and ethical standards, reducing risks and maintaining public trust.
